title: Activity no longer names shops and places players can't see
summary: The DM's edits, restocks, schedules and price changes for a shop, stock line, place or property listing now reach a player's Activity only while that player can see it.
items: A vendor in another town, a hidden black-market vendor, an unrevealed place or a listing elsewhere stays out of a player's Activity, price-change history, archived sessions and CSV export.
When the party reaches that place, or the DM reveals the vendor, its lines appear for players.
When the DM buys or sells for a character or party fund at a shop its players can't see, players keep every line and receipt, with the shop named only as "a merchant".
The DM still sees every line. Older lines that can't be matched to their shop or place now show to the DM only.
